content: The input gate INLINEFORM0 and the forget gate INLINEFORM1 control the amount of information transmitted from INLINEFORM2 and INLINEFORM3 , the candidate cell state and the previous cell state, to the new cell state INLINEFORM4 . Similarly the output gate INLINEFORM5 soft-selects which portion of the cell state INLINEFORM6 is to be used in the final hidden state.
